Title: Verify model switch functionality at runtime
Description: As a QA engineer, I want to verify the model-router switches models at runtime so that we unlock the runtime flexibility objective without redeploying. The work tests switching between single GPT, single Claude, and dual-model mode at runtime, verifies each mode produces consistent results, and confirms the dual-model comparison logic works correctly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Model mode is configurable via Key Vault config without redeploy
Single GPT mode uses Azure AI Foundry GPT; extraction and scoring pass
Single Claude mode uses Anthropic API; extraction and scoring pass
Dual mode calls both models, compares results, and flags disagreement
Latency for dual mode is reasonable (parallel calls are fast)
Model switch can be changed mid-batch without stopping current work
TalkingPoints: I'm going to verify the model-router's runtime switching works. I'll load a config into Key Vault, trigger a reread, and confirm the mode changes without redeploy. This is going to unlock the runtime flexibility objective.
